title: DashboardGithub
description: GitHub contribution-graph aggregate consumed by the GitHub dashboard widget. This is a DS-owned shape with no LP equivalent — it is computed from the GitHub API by the DS pipeline rather than exported by LP.

contributions.description: 52-week contribution grid as an array of weekly buckets, each containing 7 daily contribution counts (Sun–Sat). Used to render the GitHub-style heatmap calendar.

items.description: Seven daily contribution counts for a single week, starting Sunday.

totalContributions.description: Total contribution count across the entire grid period.

contributionTypes.description: Breakdown of total contributions by type.

pullRequests.description: Number of pull requests opened or merged.

repositories.description: Number of distinct repositories contributed to.

streak.description: Current and longest consecutive-day contribution streaks.

languages.description: Map of programming language names to total bytes of code written across all repos.

devActivity.description: Recent developer activity feed — commits, PRs, and other events ordered newest-first.

title.description: Commit message subject or PR/issue title.

hash.description: Short commit SHA. Present for commit events only.

number.description: PR or issue number. Present for pull request and issue events only.

additions.description: Lines added. Present for commit and PR events.

deletions.description: Lines deleted. Present for commit and PR events.

url.description: Full URL to the commit, PR, or issue on GitHub.

commitHours.description: 24-element array of commit counts indexed by hour of day (0 = midnight, 23 = 11 pm). Used to render the commit-hours histogram.

weeklyCommits.description: Commit counts for each of the past N weeks, ordered oldest-first.

stats.description: High-level summary statistics displayed in the widget header.

topRepos.description: Short list of the most-starred repositories for display in the repos panel.
